senateCommunication.abstract: A communication from the Division Chief of Regulatory Affairs and Directives, Bureau of Land Management, Department of the Interior, transmitting, pursuant to law, the report of a rule entitled "Revision to Regulations Regarding Locating, and Maintaining Mining Claims or Sites-Failure to Comply" (RIN1004-AF48) received during adjournment of the Senate in the Office of the President of the Senate on September 4, 2026; to the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources.
